Datia Bypoll Ticket Denial Sparks Protests and Political Debate

The Datia district is experiencing political unrest following the Bharatiya Janata Party's (BJP) decision to deny a bypoll ticket to senior leader Narottam Mishra. Supporters of Mishra protested, blocking a national highway and clashing with police. Congress leaders criticized the BJP's approach to candidates.
